flows.name: Shortest Path 1.34.2 loads with a journey and opens its settings on ForeverCore 1.8.2
steps: Install the v1.34.2 release zip (compare: equivalent to candidate b0b49a07) beside ForeverCore v1.8.2 and /reload
Print the loaded versions: ForeverCore v1.8.2, ShortestPathForever v1.34.2, both loaded
Confirm the active journey's pin, tracker and minimap route draw after the reload
Confirm the Shortest Path Forever settings page opens with every section listed
